sinopsis.es: Una niña descubre en el escaparate de una juguetería una muñeca idéntica a ella. Entra para verla de cerca, sin imaginar lo que le espera.
sinopsis.en: Amidst the chilly white winter, bright-eyed Alma, wanders through Barcelona’s cobblestone streets. Suddenly, she spots an unassuming toy shop. Her gaze is drawn to a nearly identical figure staring back at her from the storefront window. As if by magic, the shop’s door swings open. But to her bewilderment, her elusive twin is nowhere to be found.
